content: Nuntakna Thingkung
Pathian le Tuuno i kumpi tokhum pan a pusuak, limlang bang in a thiang nuntakna nguntui sia, ama in hong lak hi.
Lampi lai ah le ngunhui lang le lang ah, nuntakna thingkung om hi, tua thingkung in nam sawm le nam ni nga a, tha sim in nga sasawn lai hi: tua thingte te sia minam theampo atu in damna a hihi.
Hamsiatna zong om nawn ngawl hi: ahihang Pathian le Tuuno i kumpi tokhum om tu a; a sal te in Ama te na seam tu uh hi:
Amate in a maitang mu tu uh a; A min zong amate i talki ah om tu hi.
Tua mun ah zan om nawn ngawl a hikom; meivak zong kisam nawn ngawl tu hi, Ni tang zong kisam nawn ngawl hi; banghangziam cile Topa Pathian in amate khuavak pia tu a: amate in a tawntung in uk tu hi.
Ama in hibang in hong son hi, hi thu te sia thuman le thutak a hihi: kamsang thiangtho te i Topa Pathian in a hai ngawl in a piang tu te a sal te lak tu in vantungmi sawl hi.
Jesus Hongpai Pai Tu Hi

content.text: En vun, a manlang in kongpaitu hi: hi laibu sungah mailam thu pualakna te a zui peuma thuphatoai a hihi.

content: Keima John in hi thu te mu in ka za hi. Tua ka zak le ka mu ciang in hi thu te hong lak vantungmi peang ah bok in ka biak sawm hi.

Tasiaciang, vantungmi in, tabang vawt heak in: keima zong na naseppui ka hihi, taciang hi laibu sungah thuhilna te a zui na suapui kamsang te i naseppui zong ka hihi, tua ahikom, Pathian bia zaw in, hong ci hi.
Ama in hi laibu sung a mailam thu pualak khol nate sia ceptena khen heak in: banghangziam cile a hun cing dektak zo hi, hong ci hi.
A maan ngawl sia a maan ngawl ma in om tahen: a niin sia a niin ma in om tahen; a thutang ngawl sia a thutang ngawl ma in om tahen: a thiangtho sia a thiangtho ma in om tahen.

content.text: En vun, a manlang in kongpai tu hi; Ka kungah thaman om a, a kuamapo a sepna bang ka pia tu hi.
Keima sia Alpha le Omega, a kipatna le a tawpna, a masabel te a khakbel ka hihi.

content: Nuntakna thingkung tungah thunei tu in le khuapi sungah kongpi pan tum thei tu in thupiak nate a zui te thuphatoai te a hihi.
Banghangziam cile a puasang ah ui te, bum le ai toai te, pasal pumpi zuak te, tualthat te, milim bia te le leilot thuson te theampo om hi.

content.text: Hi thu te sia pawlpi te sungah tettipang tu in keima Jesus in vantungmi ka sawl zo hi. Keima sia David i zungpi le a suan ka hihi, taciang a tang zingsol zong ka hihi.

content: Nuntakna Tui
Thaa le monu in, Hongpai tan, ci hi. A za te in zong, hongpai tan, ci tahen. Dangtak peuma hongpai tahen. A uk theampo in nuntakna tui sia a thong in la tahen.
Hi laibu sungah mailam thu pualakna kammal te taw kisai in tetti ka pang hi, mi khatpo in hi thu te a belap ahile, hi laibu sungah a ki at ngimna te ama tungah Pathian in belap tu hi.

Taciang mi khatpo in hi laibu sung a mailam thu pualakna kammal te a dok le, Pathian in nuntakna laibu sungah a san tu te laksak tu hi, taciang a thiangtho khuapi le hi laibu sungah a ki at te zong laksak tu hi.
Hi thu te tetti a pangpa in,

content.text: A manlang in kongpai tu hi,

content: ci hi. Amen, hi tahen, Topa Jesus awng, hongpai tan.
I Topa Jesus Christ i thuthiamna sia note theampo tungah hong om tahen. amen.
